title: AETHRYS – An online Idle RPG focused on grinding, progression and no Pay-to-Win.
author: New_Ingenuity_3909
selftext:
**I’m building the Idle RPG I’ve always wanted to play. Here’s a first look!**  
Hey everyone!  
I’m a solo developer with absolutely no previous experience in programming or game development. I’m developing my game entirely with the help of AI.  
I’ve always enjoyed playing Idle RPGs, but I feel like most of them either lack appealing visuals or are heavily focused on Pay-to-Win mechanics. That’s why I decided to create my own game, AETHRYS.  
The project originally started as a side-scrolling MMO, but I eventually decided to turn it into an online Idle RPG.  
**Current features:**

* **3 playable classes** – Each with its own combat style, abilities, and visual effects.
* **Boss Rush Mode** – Fight against multiple bosses.
* **Infinite Tower** – An endless tower featuring one boss per stage.
* **Artifact Farming** – Collect powerful artifacts, such as the floating red swords you can see in the screenshot.
* **Star Compass & Equipment Progression** – Equipment is obtained through the Star Compass. You can level up the Compass to increase your chances of obtaining higher-rarity equipment, with Red-Gold being the highest rarity.
* **Wing System** – Collect and upgrade different wings.
* **Mount System** – Collect and upgrade various mounts.
* **Automatic Progression** – Auto-Draw, Auto-Equip, and Auto-Sell systems.

**Planned features:**

* Guilds
* Online PvP
* More PvE content
* Additional classes and class evolutions
* More bosses, dungeons, and events
* Long-term grinding and endgame progression
* Weekly content updates

My goal is to make the game as F2P-friendly as possible, without any Pay-to-Win mechanics. I want players to feel rewarded for their time and dedication rather than the amount of money they spend.  
I’m also planning to release weekly content updates to keep the game fresh and give players something new to look forward to.  
I’ve been working on this project for quite some time now, and I wanted to share a small first look at the game. It’s only one image for now, and everything is still under development.  
I’d love to hear your thoughts! What’s your first impression, and what features would you personally like to see in an online Idle RPG?  
Any honest feedback, criticism, or suggestions are welcome!
